newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to host U.S.-EU summit Dec 16.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to host U.S.-EU summit Dec 16.

text.p: President Bill Clinton will host the biannual U.S.-European Union summit on December 16 to discuss Bosnia, Central Europe and the Middle East, the White House said on Saturday.

A statement from White House spokesman Mike McCurry said European Union participants will be Irish Prime Minister John Bruton, president of the European Council and Jacques Santer, president of the European Commission.
Besides Bosnia, Central Europe and the Middle East, McCurry said the White House summit will also review progress made on the so-called New Transatlantic Agenda.

The agenda is aimed at promoting peace and stability across the globe, confronting the new challenges of transnational crime, fostering a healthier environment and promoting the free flow of trade and investment.
